keep_hidden includes hidden elements and template text in HTTP Markdown output

```elixir title="Elixir"
engine_config = "{\"browser\":{\"mode\":\"never\"},\"content\":{\"extract_metadata\":false,\"keep_hidden\":true}}"
{:ok, engine} = Crawlberg.create_engine(engine_config)
url = "https://example.com"
result = Crawlberg.scrape_async(engine, url)
IO.inspect(result.status_code)
IO.inspect(result.markdown.content)
```
